Provide estimates of reporting and recordkeeping hour and cost burdens of the collection of information.

TSA estimates that approximately 78 aircraft operators will apply for access to DCA annually and thus be required to respond to the information collection requirements.  Aircraft operators are required to submit information on the security coordinators and flight crew members.  TSA estimates it takes 1 hour to complete and submit a DASSP application, for an annual hour burden of 78 hours (234 over three years).  TSA uses a fully-loaded wage rate of $110.60 to estimate an annual hour burden cost of $8,627 ($25,881 over three years). Table 1 summarizes this calculation.

Provide an estimate of the annualized capital and start-up costs resulting from the collection of information.

TSA estimates that security coordinators, ASOs, and flight crew members will complete a CHRC for purposes of this ICR.  TSA estimates a fee of $15 for each STA.  TSA estimates that the additional cost for processing an estimated 314 (942 over three years) background checks based on information collected will be $4,710 annually ($14,130 over three years). In addition, TSA charges an ASO training fee of $490 per ASO (84 x 490=$41,160). There is a screening fee of $148 per aircraft per flight leg.    Table 4 breaks-out estimated STAs by respondent category and summarizes the costs.

Provide estimates of annualized cost to the Federal Government.  Also, provide a description of the method used to estimate cost, and other expenses that would not have been incurred without this collection of information.

TSA employees process both DASSP applications and ASO nomination packets.  Each DASSP application takes a TSA employee approximately 8 hours to process, resulting in an annual hour burden to TSA of 608 hours.  Employees responsible for processing DAASP applications are J-Band employees with a fully-loaded hourly wage of $104.17, for an annual hour cost burden of $65,005. to TSA.  TSA estimates it takes 70 minutes (1.1667 hours) to process an ASO packet, for an annual hour burden of 98 to TSA.  Employees responsible for processing ASO packets are a mix of I-Band and J-Band employees with a fully-loaded hourly wage rate of $89.18, for an annual hour burden cost of $8,739.  The total annual hour burden for TSA is 722 (2,166 over three years) and the total annual hour burden cost is $73,744 ($221,232 over three years).  Table 6 summarizes these calculations.
